facts.note: Watch showed twenty minutes to nine when the temple bell struck nine; uncle made a scene about it in front of everyone.
Went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone.
At 10:18 by his watch, a thump right above him in the atelier, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.
At 10:15 by his watch someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door; at 10:21 someone came quickly down. Did not see who; door was shut.
Bastien Girard came in at 10:32 by his watch; they sat together until the temple struck eleven.

added.quote: When the temple struck nine he made us all take out our watches, and then he told each of us what was wrong with ours.
added.why: At nine o'clock the other family members' watches were compared with the uncle's, and the uncle claimed to know each one's error, so the other watches' readings at nine can be inferred.
